narrationTexts: Now applying the migration edits to all 12 files.
Verifying no `db.query` calls remain outside the vendored file.
finalText:
**Migration done.** Moved all remaining `db.query` calls to `db.execute({ sql, params })` in 12 files across `support`, `billing`, `catalog`, `analytics`, `orders`, and `accounts` packages.

One holdout left on purpose: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) still uses `db.query`. It's vendored code marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so a local fix would just get lost.

Next: decide how to retire `db.query` for the vendor adapter, likely a shim in `lib/db.js` or an upstream fix in `legacy-orm`.
